paragraph: Materials. The reagent used in this study are Ludox HS-40 (40% colloidal silica, Sigma-Aldrich), sodium aluminate anhydrous (NaAlO2, Merck), sodium hydroxide solution (NaOH 50 wt%, Merck), tetrapropylammonium bromide (TPABr, Merck), CaCO3 nanoparticles (Shenyang Taiouke Chemical Co., Ltd.), ammonium chloride (NH4Cl, Merck), palm oil (Barco), hydrochloric acid (HCl, Merck) and deionized water. All reagents were used as received without any pre-treatment.
SDA1 – SDA3 were prepared according to the modified procedures described in detail in Refs. [7,28–32].
